title: Carnival Skies
blurb: Balloons, kites and a turning ferris wheel high above the midway. A brisker climb.

levels.name: Balloon Bunch
levels.intro: Break the seven orange pegs atop the balloons. Land on the plate to win your ball back.

levels.name: Kite Festival
levels.intro: Break any forty pegs. New: multiball adds two balls, and extra ball pegs give you one more.

levels.name: Bunting Lines
levels.intro: Score fifteen thousand. New: double points pegs, and a plate that catches, then bounces.

levels.name: Confetti Cannons
levels.intro: Break the nine orange pegs. New: lightning lights the nearest pegs, and spray fires three balls.

levels.name: Hot Air Balloon
levels.intro: Collect all seven gems. New: a safety net catches your next ball, and a blast ball explodes.

levels.name: Strongman Bell
levels.intro: Break every brick. New: barrier bricks show the hits they have left with colour and dots.

levels.name: Big Top
levels.intro: Break the ten orange pegs. New: bumpers fling your ball, and steel posts never break.

levels.name: Ring Toss
levels.intro: Light all eight lanterns. New: glass shatters at the first touch, and your ball flies through.

levels.name: Ticket Booth
levels.intro: Score twelve thousand. New: hit a key to open the gate of the same colour.

levels.name: Fireworks
levels.intro: Light eighteen pegs in one shot. New: fireballs burn through, and super guide shows the path.

levels.name: Hall of Mirrors
levels.intro: Break the eleven orange pegs. New: thieves steal powers, and shrinkers make your ball small.

levels.name: Sky Gates
levels.intro: Collect all eight gems. New: sky gate portals send your ball to their twin.

levels.name: Ferris Wheel
levels.intro: Light all eight lanterns. New: some pieces move. The ferris wheel slowly turns.

levels.name: Popcorn Stand
levels.intro: Break any fifty pegs. New: sticky sludge pegs slow your ball right down.

levels.name: Zeppelin
levels.intro: Break every brick. New: armour bricks only crack from blasts, fireballs and lightning.

levels.name: Banner Plane
levels.intro: Break the twelve orange pegs. New: some pieces slide. The banner plane flies to and fro.

levels.name: High Wire
levels.intro: Clear every peg. New: spikes never break, and they pop any ball that touches them.

levels.name: Balloon Race
levels.intro: Collect all eight gems. New: some balloons drift around in little loops.

levels.name: Grand Carousel
levels.intro: Break the thirteen orange pegs on the grand carousel.

levels.name: Grand Finale
levels.intro: Break all fourteen orange pegs for the grand finale.
